source: Sess runtime w1991e/sess at source_runtime_commit: the items and record components of SurfaceComponent and the interactive interaction of PatchSessionRequest from packages/spec/openapi.json, and the ISO 4217 minor-unit table of packages/core/src/currency.ts. Extracted verbatim for the Commerce builders contract test; refresh from the runtime, never by hand.

items_component.description: Line items with amounts and totals (Commerce). For anything with prices, send an items component, not a table or text. Amounts are integers in the currency’s smallest unit (cents for USD, yen for JPY, fils for BHD), with one ISO 4217 currency per component; Sess never rounds, converts or computes them. Discounts, credits and payments are negative amounts. A subtotal must equal the sum of the rows, and a total given with a subtotal must equal the subtotal plus every other totals line except paid, due and included ones; otherwise 400 INVALID_SCHEMA gives expected and actual in minor units. Every row and total is shown; nothing is collapsed. Editable quantities need an action with intent request_change, such as “Request changes”: a changed quantity can only be sent with it, and your agent replies with a new revision and updated amounts; without one, 400 INVALID_SCHEMA.

label.description: Optional caption of an items card: what the list is, a few words; at most 200. Longer fails with 400 INVALID_SCHEMA naming it; never truncated.

currency.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code with known minor units (CAD, JPY, BHD …); one per component.

select.description: The person may choose rows: one (radios) or many (checkboxes). Needs name; the result carries the chosen row indices in selected.

editable.description: The person may change the quantity of rows that carry one. Needs name and an action with intent request_change; a changed quantity is sent only with that action. The result carries quantities, one per row (null for a row without one).

rows.description: 1 to 100 rows, in order; more fail with 400 INVALID_SCHEMA (never truncated).

name.description: What one line is, shown verbatim; put quantity and unit price in detail; at most 80. Longer fails with 400 INVALID_SCHEMA naming it; never truncated.

detail.description: Optional second line under the name: quantity, unit price or a reference; at most 160. Longer fails with 400 INVALID_SCHEMA naming it; never truncated.

quantity.description: An editable quantity (only with editable ["quantity"]): the person may change it within min (default 0) and max; Sess never recomputes the amount, your agent does on its next revision. The result carries the quantities.

unit.description: Optional unit shown after an editable quantity: a word; at most 16. Longer fails with 400 INVALID_SCHEMA naming it; never truncated.

amount.description: The line amount in minor units, or null for a line with no amount.

anyOf.description: The line amount in minor units, as stated.

totals.description: Up to 8 totals lines, in order, as you state them.

label.description: A totals line's label: a word or two; at most 40. Longer fails with 400 INVALID_SCHEMA naming it; never truncated.

amount.description: The amount in minor units, as stated.

role.description: subtotal (at most one) must equal the sum of the rows; total (at most one), with a subtotal, must equal the subtotal plus the other lines except paid, due and included.

included.description: Already included in the prices (such as VAT): shown, never added. Not on a subtotal or total.

record_component.description: A read-only key/value record; keys and values are shown verbatim as text.

label.description: Optional caption above the record: a few words; at most 200. When a later page depends on an earlier answer, restate it in a record. Longer fails with 400 INVALID_SCHEMA naming it; never truncated.

anyOf.description: A row's value, shown verbatim: a string of at most 200, or a number, boolean or null. Longer fails with 400 INVALID_SCHEMA naming it; never truncated.

propertyNames.description: A row's name, shown verbatim: a word or two; at most 40. Longer fails with 400 INVALID_SCHEMA naming it; never truncated.

title.description: The page's heading: a question or a task, about 40 characters; at most 80. Longer fails with 400 INVALID_SCHEMA naming it; never truncated.

description.description: Optional context under the title: what the person decides and why, in one or two plain sentences; at most 280. Longer fails with 400 INVALID_SCHEMA naming it; never truncated.
examples: The customer was charged twice for order 1042.

locale.description: Advanced. Optional BCP 47 locale for formatting the amounts on this page, one per Surface (default: the page’s language, en). It does not translate the page.

progress.description: Advanced. Optional position in a sequence of questions: integers with 1 ≤ step ≤ total ≤ 20. The person sees it as a small counter ("1/2"). Anything else fails with 400 INVALID_SCHEMA.

components.description: The page's content, in order. How the page lays it out: Fields keep the order you send them in. Consecutive fields share one group; a heading or a text starts a new one. Each label sits beside its answer, or above it when the two do not fit, so keep it to a word or two (about 20 characters). A field's help shows under that field; give it only when it is needed. Keep choice labels short, and put any detail the decision needs in a text or record on the page: a phone's picker may cut a long choice short. Nothing is truncated: rows grow to fit their text.

items.description: One SurfaceComponent (heading, text, record, field or items). An unrecognized type fails with 400 UNKNOWN_COMPONENT.

label.description: A button: a verb, 1–3 words; at most 24. Longer fails with 400 INVALID_SCHEMA naming it; never truncated.

response_policy.description: One accepted response per revision (the only P1 policy; the default).
